name: My Cup of Coffee: The Trouble with Earl Grey
source:
You are the owner of Café Latte. When two of your regular customers seem in a bit of relationship trouble, will you be able to uncover what is really happening? Will you save their relationship?

[From [url=https://dreamgate.itch.io/trouble-with-earl-grey]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是拿铁咖啡馆的老板。当两位常客似乎陷入感情纠纷时，你能揭开事情的真相吗？你能挽救他们的关系吗？

[来自 [url=https://dreamgate.itch.io/trouble-with-earl-grey]itch.io[/url]]
